entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David, I'm calling about an order I placed a little over a month ago. I need to return a helmet.
I can certainly look into that for you. To clarify, is there a technical fault with the helmet, or is this more of a preference issue?
It's a preference. The color just wasn't quite what I expected when I saw it in person. The box is still unopened, so it's in perfect condition.
I completely understand. Getting the color right is important. Let me just pull up your account. Can you provide me with the order number?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order. You purchased the Ascent Pro helmet, and it was delivered 41 days ago.
That sounds right. Is that going to be a problem?

Not at all. According to our policy, standard items can be returned within 90 days of delivery. Since you're at day 41, you are well within the window for a full refund. We want to make sure you're happy with your gear, especially for something as critical for your safety as a helmet.
Oh, that's great news. I appreciate that. So, what's the next step?

I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email on file right now. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, we'll process your refund.

Excellent. Thank you, David. Now, since I do plan on ordering a different helmet from you, and to save us both the trouble of another return, would it be possible to get a small discount code, say 10%, for my next purchase?

I understand your request, but our policy allows for a full refund on the returned item, which is the resolution we can provide. We don't typically offer additional discounts on future orders for standard returns.
Alright, I thought it was worth asking. The free return shipping and full refund is fair enough. Thanks for your help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Have a good one.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
